content: Our method clusters text documents according to their intrinsic content. This can be understood as a type of topic detection. To understand the content of the clusters, we use Word Clouds as basic, yet intuitive, tools that summarise information from a group of documents. Word clouds allow us to evaluate the results and extract insights when comparing a posteriori with hand-coded categories. They can also provide an aid for monitoring results when used by practitioners.
